prayerExcerpt.en-US: When beset by the temptations of the devil, let us call upon the Saints, who reign with Christ.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Quando assediados pelas tentações do demônio, invoquemos os Santos, que reinam com Cristo.

meta.face: A Roman of about fifty-five, tall and lean, with a light olive complexion and a LONG face shaped like a SHIELD — a wide, flat forehead crossed by STRAIGHT, LEVEL black brows, the sides of the face running long and straight and narrowing only at the bottom to a firm, BLUNT chin; a ROMAN nose with a strong HUMP high on the bridge; deep-set, level, steady dark eyes; hollow cheeks under clear cheekbones; a firm, thin mouth; short, cropped, greying black hair combed forward in the Roman way; a SHORT, DENSE, cropped black-and-grey beard close to the jaw; the gaze fearless, toward us. Not the rectangular, square-jawed lambert, the long, jutting-chinned firmin, the broad, square denis, the oblong germanus_auxerre or the long, rectangular cornelius of cornelius_cyprian.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The face is a Roman of the third century, as the book and Wikipedia make him (sent from Rome under Pope Fabian); the staff and palm are his emblems on Santi e Beati, and the capitol he passed daily, as the book tells, stands behind him without the bull.
